description: NaSi₂N₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmc2₁ space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five N³⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.58 Å. Si⁴⁺ is bonded to four N³⁻ atoms to form corner-sharing SiN₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (1.68 Å) and three longer (1.76 Å) Si-N bond lengths. There are two inequivalent N³⁻ sites. In the first N³⁻ site, N³⁻ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Si⁴⁺ atoms. In the second N³⁻ site, N³⁻ is bonded to one Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Si⁴⁺ atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NNaSi₃ trigonal pyramids.
